tools.name: book_intro_call
tools.description: Get the Discovered Labs intro call booking details. Returns the live Calendly scheduling URL, event name, duration, and instructions for booking a free strategy call with the team.

tools.name: calculate_eval_sample_size
tools.description: Calculate the statistically valid number of prompts and API calls for an LLM brand-mention evaluation. Call when planning an eval; pass confidence (default 95), margin_of_error_pct (default 2), resamples_per_prompt (default 3), var_between and var_within. Returns unique_prompts and total_api_calls.

confidence.description: Statistical confidence level as a percentage (default 95)

margin_of_error_pct.description: Acceptable margin of error as a percentage (default 2)

resamples_per_prompt.description: Number of times to resample each prompt to reduce within-question noise (default 3)

var_between.description: Between-question variance — how much brand mention rates differ across different questions (default 0.02)

var_within.description: Within-question variance — how much the model wobbles when answering the same question (default 0.05)
